description: This file defines the GameScreen widget for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe game. It manages game state, user interactions, AI moves, and integrates with a score repository. It includes UI components such as the game board and controls, and maintains game logic for start, move handling, game over detection, and reset.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the game screen, handling user interaction, game state, and UI rendering.

classes.name: GameScreenArgs
classes.description: A class used to pass arguments (like AI mode) to the GameScreen widget.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the GameScreen widget.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Initializes dependencies and sets AI mode based on navigation arguments.

methods.name: _handleTap
methods.description: Handles user tap on a cell, processes moves, AI responses, and game over logic.

methods.name: _isGameOver
methods.description: Checks whether the game has concluded either by a winner or a draw.

methods.name: _playerToLabel
methods.description: Converts Player enum values to display labels ('X' or 'O').

methods.name: _onGameEnd
methods.description: Handles game over event, updates scores, and updates status message.

methods.name: _resetBoard
methods.description: Resets the game to start a new round.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the UI for the game screen, including board, status, and control buttons.
